name: Weakened Shield
body:
This curse is often attached to magical armor or protective wondrous items. Though the wearer may experience a sense of invulnerability when clad in such armor, she discovers its secret weakness only after it’s too late.

Type curse; Save Will DC 26

EFFECTS

The afflicted develops a pronounced vulnerability to either bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, taking a –4 penalty to AC against attacks that inflict that damage type.
